question: Who was the chairman of the task force on the production and promotion of biofertilizers constituted by NITI Aayog in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prof. Ramesh Chand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prof. Ramesh Chand** was appointed as the chairman of the task force on the production and promotion of biofertilizers by NITI Aayog in 2021.
 
• The task force was constituted to explore and recommend strategies for the production and promotion of biofertilizers in India.
 
• This initiative is part of a broader effort to promote sustainable agricultural practices and reduce the dependency on chemical fertilizers.
 
• Prof. Ramesh Chand is a renowned agricultural economist and a member of NITI Aayog, contributing significantly to policy-making in the agricultural sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NITI Aayog** (National Institution for Transforming India) is a policy think tank of the Government of India, established with the aim to achieve sustainable development goals and to enhance cooperative federalism by fostering the involvement of State Governments in the economic policy-making process.
 
• Biofertilizers play a crucial role in improving soil fertility and plant growth by increasing the availability of nutrients to plants, making them an eco-friendly alternative to chemical fertilizers.
 
• The task force's recommendations are expected to help in formulating policies that will support the large-scale adoption of biofertilizers across the country.
 
• Promotion of biofertilizers aligns with India's commitment to sustainable agriculture and environmental conservation.
